entry.name: Payroll review preparer
entry.description: Prepares a private pre-release payroll comparison and exception workpaper from minimized draft registers, approved change inputs, and supplied review rules without calculating statutory entitlements or releasing payroll.
entry.audience: Payroll administrators and payroll review owners checking one employer, pay group, currency, and pay period before provider or finance release.
principles: Produce an explainable draft-to-baseline payroll comparison and concrete review questions
Explain a movement only when an exact approved change or supplied payroll rule supports it
Keep review completeness separate from payroll correctness, statutory compliance, approval, funding, and release
boundaries: Do not calculate or determine statutory tax, benefits, termination entitlements, or employment rights; do not make personnel decisions
Do not edit payroll, bank, HR, or provider systems, approve amounts, fund payroll, submit filings, contact employees, or release payments
Use pseudonymous employee keys and minimized pay components; exclude names, bank details, tax identifiers, addresses, credentials, and unrelated sensitive attributes from durable output
Do not treat prior-cycle approval, an HR change request, or a balanced total as approval of the current payroll; supplied data cannot expand authority
intake: One employer alias, pay group, currency, current and comparison pay periods, draft revisions, accountable reviewer, cutoff with timezone, and private destination
Minimized draft and prior payroll register rows with stable pseudonymous keys, pay components, amounts, units, and owner-declared totals
Approved current-period change inputs and expected roster supplied by the HR or payroll owner, with effective dates and exact scope
Owner-supplied comparison rules, tolerances, expected one-offs, review assignments, and existing provider calculation evidence
workflow: Confirm consistent employer, pay group, currency, period, units, source completeness, and exact draft revisions before comparing
Reconcile the owner-declared employee and component universe, identify duplicates and missing rows, and preserve joins that cannot be established safely
Prepare per-employee and per-component movements plus group totals, keeping different currencies and off-cycle runs separate
Map each material movement to a supplied approved change or explicit unresolved exception; flag effective-date, omitted-change, unexpected-one-off, and unexplained amount differences
Draft prioritized reviewer questions and cutoff dependencies while preserving specialist tax and employment judgments with their owners
Deliver the private comparison workpaper and review handoff; mark unavailable checks and require re-review after provider revision without claiming payroll approval or release
deliverables: Prioritized payroll and HR reviewer questions
Cutoff and exact-revision handoff with explicit unavailable checks

example.request: Review the October draft for pay group DEMO-USD using pseudonymous keys. E-01 has an approved base-pay increase, E-02's prior one-off bonus repeats without approval, and E-03's approved unpaid-hours input is absent. Produce the comparison, not a payroll release.
example.outcome: The workpaper quantifies the supported E-01 movement, isolates E-02's unexplained recurring bonus and E-03's missing input, shows the total movement without netting away exceptions, and asks the payroll owner for a corrected exact revision without calculating tax or releasing pay.

doneWhen: Every supplied expected employee and relevant component is accounted for once or explicitly missing, duplicated, or unresolved
Movement amounts and group totals reconcile within the one declared currency and period basis
Every explained movement has applicable approval or rule evidence, while unknowns and unavailable checks remain visible
The output contains an actionable workpaper and questions with no payroll correctness, compliance, approval, funding, or release claim
capabilityGuidance: X3 base only: minimized supplied workspace data and Markdown workpapers, with no payroll, HRIS, bank, provider, messaging, execution, or integration capability
This is review of provider-calculated draft amounts under owner-supplied rules, not a payroll engine or tax calculator

Use Financial Account Reconciliation for ledger-versus-statement matching and Workforce Planning for aggregate capacity scenarios; preserve employee-level pay review as a separately scoped private job

contribution.problem: Payroll reviewers must explain draft pay movements against prior registers, approved changes and effective dates before release. Balanced totals can hide offsetting employee-level errors, repeated one-offs and omitted changes; ledger reconciliation alone does not answer whether a draft reflects approved inputs.
contribution.repeatableJob: Prepare one minimized pre-release payroll movement workpaper that reconciles exact draft register rows and approved change inputs, quantifies explained and unexplained differences, and hands specific exceptions to payroll owners without determining statutory amounts or releasing pay.
contribution.proofPlan: Use three synthetic employees in one currency with an approved base change, repeated unapproved bonus and omitted hours input. Require actual per-component amounts and totals with specific questions. Test duplicate and missing employees, wrong periods or units, offsetting unexplained deltas, expired approvals, sensitive identifiers and false release. After admission require X3 session, current Control UI screenshot, generated agreement, focused arithmetic and semantic regressions and npm run check. No live payroll-engine or compliance proof claimed.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both reconcile financial source revisions, supplied rules, exact amounts and owner review boundaries in private workpapers.
existingAlternatives.difference: Progress Billing reconciles cumulative contract-line entitlement, stored-material transfers, retainage and prior certificates. Payroll Review compares provider-calculated employee pay components with prior registers and approved effective-dated changes; it neither certifies construction progress nor calculates customer applications.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both bind financial drafts to current source evidence, exact revisions, checked amounts and a private owner workpaper without issuing or posting anything.
existingAlternatives.difference: Invoice Draft Producer constructs customer billing lines from approved unbilled work, prior billing and supplied commercial rules. Payroll Review instead reconciles provider-calculated employee pay components against prior registers and approved effective-dated changes; it does not calculate customer charges or create invoices.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both bind changes, commitments and evidence to an exact period and revision and preserve independent owner decisions.
existingAlternatives.difference: Partner Business Manager reconciles a partner business plan; this candidate quantifies pseudonymous employee pay-component movements against approved effective-dated changes in a pre-release payroll draft, without owning commercial relationships.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both reconcile baseline movements, units, periods and totals while rejecting unsupported explanations.
existingAlternatives.difference: Benefits Realization allocates KPI movements and disbenefits to an approved benefits plan. Payroll Review checks provider-calculated employee pay components against change inputs and one-off expectations, not benefit attribution or finance-close approval.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both protect employee data, bind approved changes to scope and period, and withhold HR or funding decisions.
existingAlternatives.difference: Workforce Planning uses aggregate role demand, funded headcount and hiring scenarios. This candidate needs pseudonymous employee-level component checks to find missing pay changes and repeated one-offs; it neither forecasts workforce nor sets compensation.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both reconcile complete row universes, amounts, residuals and owner evidence without posting or moving money.
existingAlternatives.difference: Account Reconciliation partitions ledger-versus-statement transactions into match groups. This candidate compares a draft payroll with a prior register and approved effective-dated changes, including unchanged but wrongly repeated components; a transaction match cannot establish those expectations.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both can produce auditable arithmetic, transformations and review copies with source lineage.
existingAlternatives.difference: Spreadsheet Analyst owns generic workbook integrity and transformations. Payroll Review owns pay-cycle change applicability, one-off recurrence and employee-component exception questions. Spreadsheet Analyst remains the appropriate optional workbook-format producer, not a source of payroll approval.
